editorial.blurb: Parlay is the lively Lincoln Park hotspot where great American food, craft cocktails, and wall-to-wall TVs create the perfect recipe for game days, brunches, and unforgettable nights with friends.
editorial.insiderTip: Hit happy hour (5-7 PM) for $10 pizzas and Monday's $20 bottomless wings, then ask your server about the large-format cocktails—they're designed to be shared and are seriously fun at the table.
